jobs.name: px_h_first
jobs.prompt: Create a finished pixel-art still for a 16:9 horizontal image-to-video shot. Visual proposition: late at night a worn-out office worker is pinned to the desk by a swarm of heavy sleep blocks. Style: crisp retro pixel art on a consistent pixel grid; chunky pixels, hard edges, no anti-aliasing, no gradients; flat color blocks with crisp 1-pixel outlines; strictly limited palette of these colors only: #0b0d1f #141a33 #222a52 #2b3050 #34406f #4a5a96 #6a7396 #6d80c4 #00e5ff #5ffbf1 #9d4edd #e94fd0 #ff5470 #ffa552 #b8c2e0 #f2f5ff. Side-view framing. Scene: a small night desk seen from the side, a desk lamp casting a cone of pale cyan light, a dark window behind, background is a single flat #0b0d1f field. Subject: one tired office worker with short dark hair, a pale cyan hoodie and a light grey face, slumped forward with both arms folded on the desk and the head resting down on the arms, eyes closed. A closed coffee mug in a warm orange tone sits on the right side of the desk, untouched. Six chunky violet sleep blocks of decreasing size hover in a loose cluster above the head, pressing down. Composition: locked poster frame; the worker and desk read as one clear silhouette within the central 60 percent; the outer thirds stay as clean empty dark field. Avoid: no typography, no readable letters, no numerals, no logos, no watermark, no UI, no subtitles, no photoreal texture, no soft shading, no blur, no anti-aliased edges, no paper texture, no grain, no aged or faded look, no sepia, no halftone dots, no clutter.

jobs.name: cl_v_last
jobs.prompt: Create a finished editorial paper-collage still for a 9:16 image-to-video B-roll clip. Visual proposition: a coffee-bean-shaped key has jammed itself into a keyhole first, so the real key labelled with sleep hangs in mid air unable to enter. Scene: perfectly flat deep-green paper field (#1E4438) with subtle uncoated paper fiber. Style: premium editorial stop-motion paper collage; black-and-white halftone photographic cut-outs of a large cross-section padlock body and its inner cylinder, with selective cream-white and printed-red (#C8451B) colored cardstock accents. Composition: vertical 9:16 locked poster frame; central subject within the middle 70 percent; generous clean color-field negative space; 3 to 6 large separable paper groups for later assemble-from-empty animation: the lock body, the cut-away cylinder, a fat coffee-bean-shaped key wedged in the keyhole, and a small ring of ordinary keys hanging just above and to the side, not touching the lock. Materials: visible printed halftone dots, crisp machine-cut edges, thin warm-cream paper keylines, soft low-opacity physical drop shadows. Constraint: it must read at a glance that the bean key got there first and the ordinary key is blocked out. Avoid: no typography, no readable letters, no numerals, no logos, no watermark, no UI, no subtitles, no glossy 3D, no photoreal environment, no clutter.
